name: Xingkai Fang
headline: MSc student in Medical Engineering at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, focused on medical imaging and biomedical signal processing.
intro: I build tools that make diagnosis and treatment clearer, faster and more useful in real clinical work. Before KTH, I studied Biomedical Engineering at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
open_to: Open to master's thesis projects, internships and graduate roles in medical imaging and medtech.
